title: sc_stale rows keep measuring staleness past one census: their packs cite a source no single refresh makes fresh
goal: Each sc_stale row of bench_pool.csv asks a question whose pack cites a source that stays past its freshness lifetime after one census or refresh (or the rows are drawn when a census runs, not by hand), and pool check's warning for an unstale row reaches a landing gate (BG-2mdkl622)
notes: Found by the SP-honlhzdc review (S3): after BG-3tfno44k, BP-3d01d974's Learn sources (7-day lifetime, no age) and BP-91b5c91e's S1512/S1862 (about 1.6 and 1.9 days past) go fresh at one census or Claude Code refresh, as the four rows BG-3tfno44k replaced did. Its check passes on 2026-10-13 (pool check prints nothing): planning must give it a check that fails while a row's stale source is within one refresh of going fresh.
